Chaos, laughter, boos in UK parliament: Kemi's attack makes Rachel Reeves shake head, say 'what'
videos
Published on Dec 04, 2025 10:55 am IST
Share Via
Copy Link
A heated exchange in the UK Parliament erupted into chaos and MPs reacted with laughter and boos as opposition leader Kemi Badenoch attacked British PM Keir Starmer. Her criticism prompted Chancellor Rachel Reeves to shake her head in disbelief and audibly say “What,” capturing the tense and theatrical atmosphere in the Commons. The confrontation unfolded amid ongoing disputes over the government’s budget, tax hikes, and the credibility of the Prime Minister, turning the session into a noisy display of political frustration and rivalry.
